In Part 1, you and the other 3 players in your group will independently perform a task. For this task, each of you will be paid a lump sum of 100 Talers.

The task is to encode numbers into words. To encode a number into a word, please replace the digits of the number with the corresponding letters from a table which you will find on the screen. Please find the example below.

Example

In this example, the given number is 09143. According to the table, 0 = "O", 9 = "M", 1 = "Z", 4 = "L", and 3 = "F". Thus, the corresponding word is "OMZLF" ("omzlf" is also correct). You should put the answer in a cell as follows:

To submit the answer, please click either the "Submit" button on the screen or "Enter" on your keyboard.

You will have 3 minutes to submit as many words as you can. You will see the countdown at the top of the page. Please note that for each new word, the table of correspondence will change.

Please note that the payment in the first part of the experiment does not depend on your performance in the task. The lump sum of 100 Talers is guaranteed independently from the number of words you will encode in 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, the task will stop automatically.

However, for each correctly encoded word, you will score 1 point. The sum of the points you will receive in 3 minutes will be your total score.

The players in your group will be ranked according to their total score in Part 1. Each of you will be assigned a symbolic medal according to the ranking. The player with the maximum total score will receive a Gold medal, the second place will receive a Silver medal, the third place will receive a Bronze medal, and the fourth place will receive a Wooden medal.

When the task is completed, each player in the group will be informed about her score as well as the relative performance in the group as pictured in the example below.

Example

Let's assume that a player's role is Player Orange and that based on the score, Player Orange took 2nd place. Thereafter, the player receives the Silver medal. In the rating, this is shown with the "Your position" sign. Player Purple took 1st place and receives the Gold medal, Player Pink took 3rd place and receives the Bronze medal, and Player Turquoise took the 4th place and receives Wooden medal.

You will have some time to observe the rating in your group. The page with the rating will be displayed for 1 minute. You will see the countdown at the top of the page. After 1 minute, you will proceed with Part 2 of the experiment.

Now, please click the "Continue" button to proceed with the task.
